# Engineer Assessment: product and research model

Status: **editable candidate project model, updated 2026-10-26**. This is the project's source for subsequent design work. The original Lab authoring snapshot and exact Define evidence remain frozen in CyberAlchemy Lab. Owner acceptance, research participation, employment use and publication require separate decisions.

## One coherent proposition

For a specified software-engineering role and level, test whether **at most three recorded case sessions, each at most ten minutes**, can identify later high-performing engineers at least as well as a longer hiring process. Session 1 uses riddles and unusual problems to elicit creativity, analysis, and ingenuity. Session 2 elicits product and software design judgment. Session 3 elicits cooperation and communication judgment. A public challenge gives participants useful feedback and supplies consented research evidence. The hiring claim is an experimental hypothesis until independently validated.

The first MVP pilot instead targets **mixed software developers** to study usability, case quality, transcription and provisional feedback. It does not supply the role-specific hiring evidence described above.

## Definition and lifecycle boundary

The original Lab [Product](../../CyberAlchemy-lab/docs/lab/reference/records/def-cal-definition-product.md), [Product Thesis](../../CyberAlchemy-lab/docs/lab/reference/records/def-cal-definition-product-thesis.md), [Research Inquiry](../../CyberAlchemy-lab/docs/lab/reference/records/def-cal-definition-research-inquiry.md), [Experiment Design](../../CyberAlchemy-lab/docs/lab/reference/records/def-cal-definition-experiment-design.md), [Measurement Method](../../CyberAlchemy-lab/docs/lab/reference/records/def-cal-definition-measurement-method.md), [Authority](../../CyberAlchemy-lab/docs/lab/reference/records/def-cal-definition-authority.md), [Evidence](../../CyberAlchemy-lab/docs/lab/reference/records/def-cal-definition-evidence.md), and [Product Capability](../../CyberAlchemy-lab/docs/lab/reference/records/def-cal-definition-product-capability.md) meanings were selected by exact registry binding in the frozen assessment Pack. Project (`CAV2-D60`) and Goal (`CAV2-D59`) were selected in the second Pack. The 85 assessment, research, software, question-lifecycle, access, feedback, product-success and recovery meanings remain proposed locally; seven further Lab meanings and two local metric meanings have fresh candidate preparation in [DEFINITIONS.md](DEFINITIONS.md) and the [connection result](../integration/lab/PRODUCT-RESEARCH-CONNECTION-RESULT.md).

Define v2 preparation ran in the Lab worktree against the original snapshot, as recorded in [historical verification](VALIDATION.md). The selected [2026-10-26 preparation](../integration/lab/DEFINE-2026-10-26.md) captures 76 historical local meanings and six exact Lab access meanings in five candidate Packs. The two new metric meanings and current carrier/relation proposal source have a fresh [Lab capture and Pack](../integration/lab/PRODUCT-RESEARCH-CONNECTION-RESULT.md). No cut confers owner review, admission, active permission or collection authority.

## Decisions still owned by people

The owner must select the first role and level, product name, intended geography, research budget, identity and data-retention policy, and the employer participation route. These are recorded as open inputs, not invented approvals. Research can develop candidate cases and protocols before those decisions, with study claims scoped accordingly.
